rules.expr: (sum by (service,environment) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator/.*",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or on (service,environment) (0 * (sum by (service,environment) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator/.*"}[5m])) or on (service,environment) (0 * max by (service,environment) (up{job="springboot"} == 1)))))

(sum by (service,environment) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator/.*",status=~"4..|5.."}[5m])) or on (service,environment) (0 * (sum by (service,environment) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator/.*"}[5m])) or on (service,environment) (0 * max by (service,environment) (up{job="springboot"} == 1))))) / on (service,environment) ((sum by (service,environment) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator/.*"}[5m])) or on (service,environment) (0 * max by (service,environment) (up{job="springboot"} == 1))) > 0)
